body:
AUTTAINE GUNSLINGER/ROGUE
CR 12

XP 19,200
Auttaine gunslinger 5/rogue 8
N Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +5; Senses Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+2 deflection, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural armor)
hp 93 (13 HD; 8d8+5d10+26)
Fort +8, Ref +13, Will +3; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Defensive Abilities evasion, improved uncanny dodge, nimble +1, trap sense +2; Resist construct resistances

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 ooze bane bone rapier +15/+10/+5 (1d6+4/18–20 plus 2d6 vs. oozes)
Ranged dragon pistol +14 (1d6+3/x4)
Special Attacks deeds (deadeye, gunslinger initiative, gunslinger’s dodge, pistol–whip, quick clear, utility shot), grit (1), gun training +3 (dragon pistol, dragon pistol), sneak attack +4d6

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 17, Con 14, Int 9, Wis 11, Cha 8
Base Atk +11; CMB +14; CMD 30
Feats Gunsmithing, Impact Critical Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Reload, Rapid Shot, Run, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (rapier)
Skills Acrobatics +8 (+12 to jump with a running start), Bluff +15, Climb +19, Disguise +4, Intimidate +10, Perception +12, Sense Motive +11, , Stealth +14
Languages Common
SQ build points (5—natural armor (2), hidden storage compartment), rogue talents (befuddling strike, convincing lie, fast getaway, powerful sneak), trapfinding +4
Gear potion of cure serious wounds, potion of displacement in compartment, leather armor, +1 ooze-bane bone rapier, dragon pistol, ring of protection +2, plague-mask, hefty trawlerman’s wax coat with several deep pockets, within which are a set of masterwork tools, a chaarskin wallet with 67 pp and the keys to his tenement, a small opium pipe, and a hipflask containing gin.
